Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.15.6.

Google Drive backup: business-number folder with weekday folders
- Backups are saved in your Drive in a folder named with the business number, with one folder per weekday (Monday ... Sunday).
- A week later the same weekday folder gets the new backup and the old one is removed, so only the last 7 days are kept.
